sections.heading: Most-asked questions
items: Is ReStory multiplayer?
No — the official store page lists single-player only.
What languages are supported?
English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (BR), Russian, Simplified Chinese — plus Traditional Chinese on this site.
Does it support controllers?
Partial controller support, including DualShock 4/5 and DualSense (official page).
Is my save backed up?
Yes — Steam Cloud is supported.
Can I share the game with family?
Yes — Family Sharing is listed.

英語、フランス語、ドイツ語、スペイン語、日本語、韓国語、ポルトガル語（BR）、ロシア語、簡体中国語——加えて当サイトは繁体中国語にも対応。

はい——Steam Cloud 対応です。
家族とシェアできる？

ko.intro: 플레이어들이 ReStory에 대해 가장 자주 묻는 질문을 공식 스토어 페이지에서 답하고, 아직 모르는 내용은 정직하게 '미검증'으로 표시합니다.

sections.heading: 가장 많이 묻는 질문
items: ReStory는 멀티플레이인가요?
아니요 — 공식 스토어 페이지에 싱글 플레이 전용으로 등록되어 있습니다.
어떤 언어가 지원되나요?
영어, 프랑스어, 독일어, 스페인어, 일본어, 한국어, 포르투갈어(브라질), 러시아어, 중국어(간체) — 이 사이트에서는 중국어(번체)도 지원합니다.

일부 지원하며 DualShock 4/5와 DualSense를 포함합니다(공식 페이지).
세이브는 백업되나요?
네 — Steam Cloud가 지원됩니다.
가족과 게임을 공유할 수 있나요?
네 — Family Sharing이 등록되어 있습니다.

es.intro: Las preguntas más rápidas que hacen los jugadores sobre ReStory, respondidas desde la página oficial de la tienda, más un honesto 'sin verificar' cuando aún no lo sabemos.

sections.heading: Las preguntas más frecuentes
items: ¿ReStory es multijugador?
No: la página oficial de la tienda lo lista solo para un jugador.
¿Qué idiomas son compatibles?
Inglés, francés, alemán, español, japonés, coreano, portugués (BR), ruso y chino simplificado, más el chino tradicional en este sitio.
¿Admite mandos?
Soporte de mando parcial, incluidos DualShock 4/5 y DualSense (página oficial).
¿Mi partida se guarda?
Sí: Steam Cloud es compatible.
¿Puedo compartir el juego con mi familia?
Sí: Family Sharing aparece en la lista.

sections.heading: Aún en verificación
sections.body: El contenido del DLC, la dificultad exacta, la duración del juego y el estado de los parches posteriores al lanzamiento están en nuestra lista de sin verificar; consulta la guía de notas del parche para novedades.

pt-BR.intro: As perguntas mais rápidas que os jogadores fazem sobre ReStory, respondidas com base na página oficial da loja — além de 'não verificado' honesto onde ainda não sabemos.

sections.heading: As perguntas mais feitas
items: ReStory é multiplayer?
Não — a página oficial da loja lista apenas para um jogador.
Quais idiomas são suportados?
Inglês, francês, alemão, espanhol, japonês, coreano, português (BR), russo, chinês simplificado — além de chinês tradicional neste site.
Suporta controles?
Suporte parcial a controles, incluindo DualShock 4/5 e DualSense (página oficial).
Meu save tem backup?
Sim — Steam Cloud é suportado.
Posso compartilhar o jogo com a família?
Sim — Family Sharing está listado.

sections.heading: Ainda em verificação

ru.intro: Самые частые вопросы игроков о ReStory, отвеченные по официальной странице магазина — плюс честные пометки «не проверено», где мы пока не знаем.

sections.heading: Самые частые вопросы
items: ReStory — мультиплеер?
Нет — официальная страница магазина указывает только одиночную игру.
Какие языки поддерживаются?
Английский, французский, немецкий, испанский, японский, корейский, португальский (БР), русский, упрощённый китайский — плюс традиционный китайский на этом сайте.
Поддерживаются ли контроллеры?
Частично, включая DualShock 4/5 и DualSense (официальная страница).
Сохранения резервируются?
Да — поддерживается Steam Cloud.
Можно делиться игрой с семьёй?
Да — указан Family Sharing.

sections.heading: Ещё проверяем
sections.body: Контент DLC, точная сложность, продолжительность и статус патчей после релиза в нашем списке непроверенного — обновления смотрите в гайде по патчам.

pages.title: Atari 2600 Repair Guide
pages.metaTitle: ReStory Atari 2600 Repair Guide
pages.metaDescription: How to repair the Atari 2600 in ReStory: device profile, the repair loop, weak points and FAQ. Repair steps being verified.
pages.intro: Atari 2600 is Atari 2600 — one of the repairable devices in ReStory. It belongs to the Consoles family. It is part of the officially licensed Atari line — the headline hardware of the whole game.

sections.heading: The repair loop on this device
sections.body: Every device in ReStory follows the same five-step loop. Exact part details for the Atari 2600 are being verified:
items: Accept the job
Greet the customer and take in the Atari 2600.
Disassemble
Open it with your screwdriver — layout being verified for this device.
Inspect & note
Check every part and record states in your notebook.
Clean & replace
Brush dirty parts; replace only what is truly broken or missing.
Reassemble & deliver
Put it back together in the right order and hand it over.

sections.heading: Watch out for
sections.body: Typical weak points based on the device type (details being verified):
items: The woodgrain shell is fragile — handle it gently.
Cartridge slot contacts get dirty fast.
Officially licensed line: worth chasing the licenses for.

sections.heading: Atari 2600 FAQ
items: Is the Atari 2600 really official?
Yes — Atari is officially licensed in ReStory (Steam page).
What usually breaks on it?
Cartridge contacts and the power switch — specifics being verified.
Is it worth repairing early?
It is a highlight device; you will likely need licenses first.
Does it need special tools?
Being verified — likely the screwdriver plus cleaning supplies.

sections.heading: Per-device steps are being verified
sections.body: Exact disassembly order, part names and common traps for the Atari 2600 are on our unverified list. We will fill this page in as we verify them in-game.

en.title: Atari 2600 Repair Guide
en.metaTitle: ReStory Atari 2600 Repair Guide
en.metaDescription: How to repair the Atari 2600 in ReStory: device profile, the repair loop, weak points and FAQ. Repair steps being verified.
en.intro: Atari 2600 is Atari 2600 — one of the repairable devices in ReStory. It belongs to the Consoles family. It is part of the officially licensed Atari line — the headline hardware of the whole game.

sections.heading: The repair loop on this device
sections.body: Every device in ReStory follows the same five-step loop. Exact part details for the Atari 2600 are being verified:
items: Accept the job
Greet the customer and take in the Atari 2600.
Disassemble
Open it with your screwdriver — layout being verified for this device.
Inspect & note
Check every part and record states in your notebook.
Clean & replace
Brush dirty parts; replace only what is truly broken or missing.
Reassemble & deliver
Put it back together in the right order and hand it over.

sections.heading: Watch out for
sections.body: Typical weak points based on the device type (details being verified):
items: The woodgrain shell is fragile — handle it gently.
Cartridge slot contacts get dirty fast.
Officially licensed line: worth chasing the licenses for.

sections.heading: Atari 2600 FAQ
items: Is the Atari 2600 really official?
Yes — Atari is officially licensed in ReStory (Steam page).
What usually breaks on it?
Cartridge contacts and the power switch — specifics being verified.
Is it worth repairing early?
It is a highlight device; you will likely need licenses first.
Does it need special tools?
Being verified — likely the screwdriver plus cleaning supplies.

sections.heading: Per-device steps are being verified
sections.body: Exact disassembly order, part names and common traps for the Atari 2600 are on our unverified list. We will fill this page in as we verify them in-game.

es.title: Guía de reparación de Robodog
es.metaTitle: Guía de reparación de Robodog en ReStory
es.metaDescription: Cómo reparar el Robodog en ReStory: perfil del dispositivo, bucle de reparación, puntos débiles y preguntas frecuentes. Pasos de reparación en verifi…
es.intro: El Robodog es un perro robot tipo Aibo — uno de los dispositivos reparables de ReStory. Pertenece a la familia de gadgets y juguetes. Una parodia de perro robot estilo Aibo.

sections.heading: El bucle de reparación en este dispositivo
sections.body: Todos los dispositivos de ReStory siguen el mismo bucle de cinco pasos. Los detalles exactos de las piezas del Robodog están en verificación:
items: Acepta el trabajo
Saluda al cliente y recoge el Robodog.
Desmonta
Ábrelo con tu destornillador — la disposición interna de este dispositivo está en verificación.
Inspecciona y anota
Revisa cada pieza y anota su estado en tu cuaderno.
Limpia y reemplaza
Cepilla las piezas sucias; reemplaza solo lo que esté realmente roto o falte.
Reensambla y entrega
Vuelve a montarlo en el orden correcto y entrégalo.

sections.heading: Цикл ремонта для этого устройства
sections.body: Каждое устройство в ReStory проходит один и тот же цикл из 5 шагов. Точные детали для Robodog ещё не проверены:

zh-TW.title: Robodog 修復指南
zh-TW.metaTitle: ReStory Robodog 修復指南
zh-TW.metaDescription: 如何在 ReStory 中修復 Robodog：設備檔案、修復循環、弱點與 FAQ。修復步驟核實中。
zh-TW.intro: Robodog 是 Aibo 式電子狗——維修物語中可修復的設備之一。它屬於小玩意與玩具家族，是 Aibo 式電子狗的惡搞。

sections.heading: 這臺設備的修復循環
sections.body: 維修物語中每臺設備都遵循同一套 5 步循環。Robodog 的精確零件細節核實中：
items: 接單
招呼顧客並收下 Robodog。
拆解
用螺絲刀打開設備——本設備的內部佈局核實中。
檢查並記錄
逐一檢查零件，把狀態記進筆記本。
清潔與更換
用刷子清潔髒零件；只更換真正損壞或缺失的零件。
組裝並交付
按正確順序裝回去並交還顧客。

sections.heading: 注意事項
sections.body: 根據設備類型的常見弱點（細節核實中）：
items: 關節電機和傳感器。
電池倉。
最複雜的玩具修復。

sections.heading: Robodog FAQ
items: Robodog 是什麼？
Aibo 式電子狗的惡搞。
哪裡會壞？
電機、傳感器、電池——核實中。
是最難的玩具嗎？
機器人零件很多——大概率是後期。
值得費這個勁嗎？
全收集的獎盃設備。

sections.heading: 逐設備步驟核實中
sections.body: Robodog 的精確拆解順序、零件名稱與常見坑都在待補清單上。我們會在遊戲內實測後補齊本頁。
